messages:
sarah: hey team — quick ping: opened PR #4321 that tweaks KV prefetch to skip tombstones in the hot path. small change but touches batching. can someone take a look? targeting merge in today's 17:00 PT traffic window.

mike: link?

sarah: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 — main change is in runtime/kv/prefetch.cc, ~30 lines. added a boolean gate and a microbench.

riyad: i'll take a look, aiming for ~30m. any perf numbers or staging runs?

sarah: local microbench showed ~0.5% p50 improvement, p99 stable. ran staging e2e earlier, saw one flaky test fail (test_batch_coalesce) — rerunning now. added a gate env var: `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH_SKIP_TOMBSTONES`. small config diff:```diff
- prefetch_enabled = true
+ prefetch_enabled = true
+ prefetch_skip_tombstones = true
```

ana: quick ask — can we ensure the gate defaults to off in dedicated/enterprise profiles? also please add a short changelog line.

mike: also nit on test name, `test_prefetch_tombstone_handling` would be clearer.

ci-bot: CI: running checks for PR #4321 (build 982)

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #4321 — build 982

sarah: thanks — addressed the test name, added changelog.md entry at docs/changelog/2026-03-17-kv-prefetch.md, and set defaults so enterprise profiles keep the flag off. pushed new commit.

riyad: left one comment about a possible race in the prefetch map (concurrent erase + read). small suggestion: wrap the erase in `std::scoped_lock(prefetch_map_mutex)` and add a debug-only ASSERT to catch it.

sarah: good catch — pushed fix with lock and a unit test to repro the race.

ci-bot: CI: running checks for PR #4321 (build 983)

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #4321 — build 983

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: staging at 18:00 PT for PR #4321 (canary window: 18:00-18:30).

mike: LGTM other than riyad's confirm. i'll hold off approving until riyad is happy.

riyad: re-reviewed, race fix looks good, unit test reproducer is sensible. approved.

mike: approved.

sarah: thanks everyone — merging now and will watch canary metrics (latency, error-rate, batch sizes). will post followup if anything odd shows up. :tada:

mike: thx — appreciate the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: Merge complete. PR #4321 merged to main. Canary deployed to staging at 18:00 PT.
